name: @yottameta/yotta-logwatch
description: Yuancha — a zero-dependency security log analysis & detection engine for AI agents: parses auth/secure, Web access logs (common/combined), PowerShell script-block logs and Windows Event Log (Security/System, key=value / wevtutil text / XML exports) with the pure Python 3.8+ standard library; auto-sniffs the log type; detects brute-force / webshell / scanning / abnormal login / suspicious script blocks / account operations / suspicious process / log clearing; outputs a timeline with Chinese teaching-style reports. Triggers when the user provides log files, asks to analyze login / Web access / PowerShell logs, or traces intrusion traces or abnormal activity. Boundaries: read-only local log files; no network, no proactive scanning, never modifies any content.
